project.name: extensibility (domain module)
project.description: Extensibility domain (Session 7 — "Beyond the BFF"): the five ways to extend or integrate the platform, side by side — Custom Fields (a gift message that snapshots onto the order), Custom Objects (a feature flag the storefront obeys with no deploy), Messages (an order timeline + an idempotent poll-based consumer), API Extensions (cart rules the platform enforces for every client, hosted here behind a tunnel), and the Import API (a bulk price feed). Subscriptions are taught as a concept: their destinations are cloud queues only, which Connect provisions in Session 8. Depends on `platform` only — it carries its own cart / order reads and calls the order module over HTTP.
